text: Provides an embedding API with registry, functions, schemas, and multi-language SDK support

text: Enterprise maintains SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance

text: Provides a unified platform spanning storage, feature, retrieval, and training without fragmented stack
